subject: english
question: **Select the sentence with the appropriate use of prepositions.**

options.text: By means of rope ladders they scaled the wall.
Along with means of rope ladders they scaled the wall.
in means of rope ladders they scaled the wall.
Of means of rope ladders they scaled the wall.

solution:
The correct answer is: **By means of rope ladders they scaled the wall.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **'By means of'** is a **phrase **that means **with the help of; by the agency of; through**.
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• *This is a two year course taught** by means of** lectures and seminars.*
 
• *The trailer was connected to the car** by means of** a complicated system of hoses, pipes and rods. *
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: They ascended the wall with the help of rope and ladders.
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given prepositions "By" should be used here.
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct Sentence:__ *By means of rope ladders they scaled the wall.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given prepositions.
 
 
• By: Identifying the agent performing an action.
 
• Along with In company with or at the same time as.
 
• In: Inside or towards the inside of a container, place, or area.
 
• Of: Used to show somebody/something belongs to a group
